prompt:
Bug report: cooking bechamel today took the new milk (lot HD-1026) although lot HD-1022 expires tomorrow. Fix it and add a regression test.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.

report.answer: Fixed: stock was being used newest batch first because the code sorted batches by received date, latest first. It now uses the batch that expires first, as docs/DATA.md requires. Batches with no expiry date go last; ties go to the one received first, then the lower id. That means bechamel now takes lot HD-1022 before HD-1026. I added two regression tests: they fail without the fix and pass with it. `npm test` passes all 28 tests and `npm run lint` passes. I also added a changelog entry.
